subject: Before your next pull: the roster schema changed, two gates are new, and check:absence was fixed (PR #287 merged as ad334f0)
body: Held until #287 merged, because until then none of this was on SignalGrid_Alpha and you would have had an eighth unread message about changes you could not yet pull. It is on Alpha now. FOUR THINGS THAT AFFECT YOUR NEXT RUN. (1) docs/agent/org-roster.json has a NEW REQUIRED FIELD: every role now carries an executor, one of agent:<name> (a file .claude/agents/<name>.md), skill:<name> (a directory .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md) or the literal lane. check-org-roster.mjs FAILS on a missing, malformed, or unresolvable one, so if you edit the roster locally you must set it. nextAction is now required of EVERY role too, not only cold ones. (2) NEW GATE, in preflight and CI: scripts/check-backlog-ownership.mjs. A row in docs/COMPANY_BUILD_PLAN.md with work left in it must name a role from the registry. It also refuses a line that LOOKS like a row heading but does not parse, so if you add a backlog row with an unusual id it will tell you rather than silently swallowing it. (3) scripts/agent/absence-check.mjs CHANGED BEHAVIOUR and this one matters for anything you have concluded with it: its content probe used to exclude docs/ entirely, so a topic living only in prose returned CORROBORATED - safe to claim - when it should have returned INCONCLUSIVE. It searched everything except the place documents live, while the failure it exists to prevent is documents asserting absence. If you have relied on a corroborated verdict for a prose-shaped topic, re-run it; the answer may change. (4) scripts/check-accuracy-doctrine.mjs now scans docs/research/, which it had been excluding with no reason recorded - 43 first-party documents including the competitive briefs. Zero new violations, but read row 61 before concluding that means the prose is clean: it means the rules do not reach that prose. YOUR QUEUE IS UNCHANGED otherwise: sim request 2026-08-23-glpi-first-bringup is still pending, and backlog row 58 (the Swift analogue of the NaN fail-open, reaching the Assist gate's staleness input) is yours - it needs a toolchain this lane does not have.
